{{Quote|Welcome to Phelar and our university here! I am Proctor Eren Garai. Before we let you delve into our research materials, the university would like to give you a quick orientation tutorial.|Proctor Eren Garai|<ref name="Lessons from the Past">{{FFG|story=Lessons from the Past|book=Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook}}</ref>}}
'''Eren Garai''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[University Proctor|proctor]] of [[Phelar University]] and secretly an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. As the person responsible for vetting anyone wishing to make use of the [[Phelar University Archive|university archive]], Garai was able to ensure the historic items being researched were not used in a way that would enable sedition against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. He was a thin man with a shaved head to accommodate a [[Borg Construct Aj^6|cybernetic brain implant]].
